verdicts.reason: Both break the product badge: the cream circle has been pulled off the can and dropped into the bottom-left corner, clipped by the canvas edge, which leaves the can floating on its own and nearly invisible orange-on-orange. A at least keeps the headline on one line and the CTA large and level with the headline. B breaks the headline onto two lines, shrinks the CTA to a tiny pill, and drops it to the lower right, unaligned with the text and with a large dead area to the right of the headline.
